caption:
Want more speed? Train the downswing, not just the backswing. ⚡

The med ball downswing slam trains the order speed comes from: shift into your lead side, hips fire, trunk follows, arms finish.

✅ 3 x 5 each side, full rest between sets
✅ Shift first, then slam with intent
❌ Don't lead with your arms or go soft on the effort

Send this to your golf buddy who needs a few more yards.
